title: plan-review axis-1 findings (T-P0-388 AC1 contract)
description: AC-level structured review output emitted by each fresh axis-1 subagent and aggregated into round1.json. Consumed by T4 (adjudication + brief) and T5 (events.jsonl writeback). The terminal verdict set is {pass,concern} (AC1); subjective items carry the NON-terminal sentinel verdict='defer' + route='human' (AC5) -- the machine must never pronounce a terminal verdict on a subjective matter (bearing wall). 'defer' reconciles AC1's {pass,concern} with AC5's 'no terminal verdict, only route=human'; it is documented, not a silent gap-fill.

run_id.description: Stable id for one /plan-review run; T6 aggregates incremental review by run, T5 stamps each event with it.

tasks_reviewed.description: Window task ids that were reviewed (for coverage auditing).

task.description: Task id (maps to T5 events task_id); null ONLY for a global/cross-task finding added by T4's global pass.

ac.description: The hit AC (e.g. 'AC3'); null for a task-level finding. Maps to T5 events ac_ref. AC-level granularity preserved for T5 writeback + T6 incremental.

dimension.description: The NATURE of the finding. objective = machine-ownable well-formedness; subjective = should-build/scope/intent/irreversible/security (route=human, never terminal). 'harden-L0' is NOT a dimension -- it is a ROUTE for an OBJECTIVE defect L0 missed (AC6).

verdict.description: Terminal verdict in {pass,concern} (AC1). 'defer' = non-terminal sentinel reserved for subjective items (AC5). No 'fail' (objective fail caught by L0; subjective fail does not exist).

confidence.description: Coarse; drives routing ONLY (a low-confidence concern routes human), never displayed as a number.

evidence.description: Cites a concrete AC / Verification line (AC1). Refute-by-default: a concern with no concrete evidence is itself suspect.

suggested_fix.description: Required non-empty for concern/defer; may be empty for pass.

route.description: pass=>none; objective concern=>human OR harden-L0 (the latter iff it is an objective defect L0 should have caught, AC6); subjective(defer)=>human. route=harden-L0 requires dimension=objective AND verdict=concern.
